message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Implemented src/cachetools/tagged.py: TaggedCache(maxsize) backed by a private _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) (1 slot per value). put validates/dedupes tags before any state change (bare string, nonstring entries, non-iterables -> ValueError; generators OK), deep-copies values on input, replaces old tag memberships on overwrite and refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A extension). get returns a detached deep copy, raises KeyError on miss, refreshes recency. invalidate(tag) removes exactly live tagged entries and returns the count. LRU evictions are recorded via a popitem override and pruned from tag maps, so evicted keys leave no stale memberships on reuse. maxsize must be a positive int excluding bool. Added tests/test_tagged.py (45 tests covering R01/R02/R02-extension/R03) plus HANDOFF.md. Verified: acceptance_public.py 2 passed, upstream tests/ 217 passed unchanged, total 262 passed.","completion_asserted":true}
